title: Aspiration event
banner: DRAFT, NOT clinically reviewed. Fictional scenario specification; never imported, published or shown to learners.
learning_objectives: Confirm tube position before use and raise the head of the bed.
Report respiratory distress after a feed starts.

expected_actions.text: Confirm tube position before each use and do not feed if it cannot be confirmed.
Keep the head of the bed raised unless contraindicated.
Stop the feed and escalate for respiratory distress.

gaps: No published clinical scenario may exist until the review phase: this is a specification only.
The branching content, consequences and scoring are the author's reading of the cited sources and have had no clinical review.
Management after a witnessed aspiration is not drawn from a source read.
